_comment: Apple App Site Association — template for Universal Links.
_critical: Must be served as application/json, NOT application/json-www-association-or-similar.
Must NOT be served with the .json extension in the URL (Apple drops it).
Must be served over HTTPS with a valid (not self-signed) cert.
Must NOT be redirected (200 OK only, no 30x).
iOS caches this file aggressively — to force refresh, change the Team ID or
bundle ID briefly (or wait up to 24 hours).
and confirm Apple's CDN sees it. Without that, Universal Links won't fire.
